description: Visual npm scripts manager for VSCode and any VSCode-based editor: scan all npm projects in the workspace, run scripts with one click, automatically track every listening port/service of the script, kill or restart a single service by port, and detect scripts started outside the editor (other IDEs / terminals) (VSCode, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.)
cmd.runScript.title: Run Script
cmd.stopScript.title: Stop Script
cmd.restartScript.title: Restart Script
cmd.restartService.title: Restart This Service
cmd.showOutput.title: Show Output
cmd.killService.title: Kill This Service
cmd.killExternal.title: Kill External Process
cmd.openInBrowser.title: Open in Browser
cmd.refresh.title: Refresh Project List
config.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded when scanning for package.json
config.pollIntervalMs.description: Port/process poll interval for running scripts (ms)
config.env.description: Environment variables injected into every script process started by the extension, e.g. { "CODE_INSPECTOR": "1" } — handy for opt-in dev tools that read env flags (code-inspector-plugin etc.)
